description: TrustAnchor has two constructors (new, from_cert) but no From/TryFrom impls. A 'impl From<Certificate> for TrustAnchor' would make 'anchors.iter().map(TrustAnchor::from_cert).collect()' work as a method reference. More importantly, after fixing from_cert to take &Certificate (PKIX-841.21), 'impl From<&Certificate> for TrustAnchor' would complete the conversion story. Without From, callers write verbose explicit constructor calls where a natural conversion exists.
title: Missing From<&Certificate> or TryFrom for TrustAnchor — only TrustAnchor::new and from_cert exist
